theorem.name: EmbeddedRenormalizedSMEquivalenceClosureTheorem
theorem.statement: At the adopted one-shared-physical-primitive/profile standard, the selected MTT SM branch is mapped to the same renormalized Standard Model action and common-scheme parameter point. The selected multi-loop transport closes the precision parameter map, and the renormalized observable-functor theorem promotes action equality to equality of perturbative SM observables. All twelve scoped obligations pass; therefore true SM equivalence is closed at this declared standard. Strict no-knob selection and the listed stronger geometric/foundational upgrades remain open.
